public_source_heads.source_scope: exact public source commit inspected as external implementation precedent

exact_continuation: Encode a real-JsonlEventSink E1-projection-fails/E2-projection-succeeds regression and require a highest-contiguous-projected-prefix invariant. Specify a reserved sink-owned event_log_id that caller id/event_id cannot control and that is identical in canonical log, projection and downstream delivery. Define same-process projection-gap latching plus fresh-process cursor reconciliation, with cursor advancement in the same mission-view replacement only after every preceding projected event is reduced. Extract the stable events.lock -> mission-view.lock all-generation snapshot/iterator and add deterministic rollover/no-deadlock coverage. Add legacy full-rebuild fallback for absent/unlocatable authoritative cursor. Keep power-loss fsync ordering as a separate scope branch, and continue optional Manager transition_id provenance independently.

run_findings.candidate_007_status: materially strengthened: exact identity alone is insufficient; progress must be the highest contiguous projected prefix
run_findings.candidate_007_gap_leapfrog: E1 canonical append can survive a swallowed Mission View projection failure; E2 can later append and project successfully. A cursor advanced merely to latest successful E2 would permanently seal the earlier E1 hole.
run_findings.candidate_007_non_idempotent_guard: round.review.completed may increment review.rejected_attempts, so timestamp overlap or replaying later already-applied events is not a generally safe repair
run_findings.candidate_007_required_invariant: cursor means every projected canonical event at or before it was reduced into the same persisted Mission View in canonical order
run_findings.candidate_007_gap_policy: after any projection failure canonical logging may continue, but later Mission View projection/cursor advancement must catch up the gap first or remain fail-closed behind it
run_findings.candidate_007_identity_scope: current _event_id/eventKey helpers trust optional event_id/generic id/other convenience fields; normalize_event_envelope does not mint or validate a globally unique canonical event identity
run_findings.candidate_007_identity_proposal: mint a reserved sink-owned event_log_id before canonical append; keep caller semantic id/event_id separate; legacy rows without authoritative identity fall back to full stable rebuild
run_findings.candidate_007_restart_policy: fresh sink/process must reconcile persisted cursor against stable canonical log before allowing a later projected event to advance the view
run_findings.candidate_007_cursor_atomicity: projected cursor advances in the same mission-view.json replacement as the state reduced through that event
run_findings.candidate_007_external_precedent: Marten discussion #4953 (2026-07) reproduced projection progress crossing an outstanding event; v9.16.1 added transaction-evidence gating and reporter confirmed repro and real bulk import completed without missing projected events
run_findings.candidate_007_precedent_scope: Marten's PostgreSQL transaction-evidence mechanism is not directly transferred; only the fail-closed contiguous-progress principle is used
run_findings.candidate_006_status: maintained: correctness-first stable all-generation replay remains the shared snapshot/fallback primitive
run_findings.candidate_006_all_generations: event_log_paths already returns .2/.3/.../.1/current oldest-to-newest; current Mission View bootstrap still reads only .1 and current tails
run_findings.candidate_006_pinned_fd_status: deferred until contiguous projection catch-up exists because early release widens logged-but-unprojected exposure
run_findings.canonical_log_power_loss_scope: events.jsonl append and rotation have no explicit observed file/directory fsync; mission-view temp file does fsync before replace. Current candidate claims process-restart/projection-exception consistency only, not power-loss durability
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains a provenance-only branch
run_findings.candidate_005_lineage_scope: provenance only; not authorization, authentication, capability, fencing or CAS
